messages:
Tara: Planning a dry-run for private-deploy hardening tomorrow 08:30 PDT. Goal: validate RBAC policy changes, KMS key swap, audit-forwarding to SIEM, and netpol egress via outbound-proxy. Need 2 infra + 1 sec observer.
Ben: I can do infra. What environments? staging + canary-onprem-eu?
Tara: staging then canary-onprem-eu. If all good we'll repeat in canary-onprem-nyc later.
Hannah: Two quick asks before roll: 1) what exact RBAC delta are we applying? 2) are we toggling hostNetwork pods?
Diego: RBAC delta: tighten `view` on `secrets` to exclude non-platform serviceaccounts. Patch will be in `rbac-restriction-2026-04.yaml`. We'll do a dry-apply with `kubectl auth reconcile --dry-run=server` first.
Priya: For KMS steps, using our Vault cluster with HSM-backed transit. Sequence: snapshot -> soft-disable -> promote-standby -> verify decrypt. Commands: `vault write transit/keys/ri-inference/rotate`, `vault write transit/keys/ri-inference disabled=true`, `vault write transit/keys/ri-inference-promote promote=true`. Confirmed with Vault ops.
Maya: Add note: update clients' key thumbprint cache TTL to 2m for the test. Runtime team will override in configmap.
Diego: Netpol approach: apply an egress policy in the app namespace to force egress through the outbound-proxy service. Sample: ```apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: force-egress-proxy
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: outbound-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 3128
```
Ben: We'll also enforce node-level metadata block for the test on canary nodes: `iptables -I OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -j REJECT` applied via daemonset.
Hannah: How are we validating audit forwarding? Expectation: events appear in SIEM within 90s and include `actor.ip`, `user.agent`, and `action=rbac:update` tags.
Priya: Filebeat config will add `tags: ["env:canary-onprem-eu","test:priv-hardening-dryrun","incident:DR-2026-04-13"]` and pipeline ensures a `rbac_action` mapping. Use `curl 'http://siem.internal/api/search?q=test:priv-hardening-dryrun&size=5'` to validate.
Tara: Sec observer should watch for dropped egress, missing audit events, or Vault proxy token leakage. Hannah, can you watch Vault proxy logs?
Hannah: Yes. I'll tail `/var/log/vault-proxy.log` and look for `WARN token-forwarding` entries.
Diego: Rollback steps if KMS promotion causes client failures: 1) promote original key back `vault write transit/keys/ri-inference disabled=false` 2) restart runtime pods to flush cache 3) remove netpol forcing proxy.
Ben: For RBAC rollback: reapply `rbac-allowlist-restore.yaml` from s3://runbooks/rbac-backups/ then run: `kubectl auth reconcile -f rbac-allowlist-restore.yaml`.
Maya: Add detection checks: filebeat -> SIEM rule `MissingAuditEvents` triggers when no `action=rbac:update` events within 120s of the change. PagerDuty rule set to notify sec-oncall.
Priya: Note: Vault proxy uses short-lived tokens from the auth-manager. Ensure auth-manager refresh window isn't >30s or we might see transient failures during key rotate.
Diego: We'll schedule staging run at 02:00, canary-at-eu at 05:30, canary-nyc at 11:00. Tara will coordinate final go/no-go.
Tara: Action items: Ben: apply iptables daemonset + netpol in staging; Diego: prepare RBAC patch and KMS steps in runbook; Priya: filebeat tag + SIEM query saved; Hannah: watch vault-proxy logs and hostPath admission check; Maya: run the drill and trigger PagerDuty if detection fires.
sec-bot: Created incident DR-2026-04-13 (type: dry-run). Runbook: /ops/runbooks/priv-deploy-hardening-dryrun.md
Ben: One more - confirm kubelet `--protect-kernel-defaults` and `HostPath` admission plugin active in canary cluster. I'll list apiserver flags and post.
Tara: Good catch. Keep notes brief in the runbook. Final reminder: label all test artifacts with `test=priv-hardening-dryrun` so we can filter later.
Maya: Thanks everyone. We'll start the staging window tomorrow. Short postmortem expected within 48h.
Diego: :thumbsup:
Hannah: I'll add the GH PR link with RBAC diff when ready.
sec-bot: Incident DR-2026-04-13 status=scheduled, responders=[Ben,Diego,Hannah], notify=pagerduty
Tara: If anyone can't make the windows DM me and I'll find backups.
